_comment: Scene for the theatre bar at the bottom. Renderer keys: 'windows' with 'at' (where the engine puts each top-level window on a 2560x1440 screen; leave it out to use the file's own position until it is measured with render_gui.py --verify), 'rows' and 'listRows' (sample rows per list), 'height', 'hide' and 'place' (what the code sizes, hides or moves in this state); 'samples' (texts for named text boxes). Harness keys: 'setup' (recipe steps from the clean state; see wiki/Game-Recipes.md), 'captures' (extra named captures with their own steps), 'expect' (widgets that must be visible in the capture: proof that the recipe brought the screen up), 'crop' (x, y, width, height cut out of a capture). 'manual' and 'checklist' are what is left for a human.

windows.name: theatre_selection_window
windows._note: Vanilla's own window, not overridden (RBM's GFX Overhaul moves it to y 93). It stacks the boxes in elements_list, a grid with a slot of 1x1, and honours each box's own position: x 430 in vanilla, 310 in the mod, so the right edge stays at 730. Its height is the screen's less 240.

captures.name: navy
captures._note: A fleet selected: the theatre boxes of the navy.

captures.name: air
captures._note: An airbase selected: the air theatres.

_note: Always on screen; the recipe only makes sure an army exists so the bar has an entry. Much of it is positioned by the engine.
